shortDescription: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd. bulls are brushing off a $100 billion market value wipeout over four months, saying the Chinese battery maker’s technology moat leaves it well positioned for the long-term global energy transition, according to Bloomberg.

title: CATL Bulls Dismiss De-CATLization Fears After $100 Billion Selloff
